name: Fieldflow Calm tenant backoffice route contract

presentationComposition.rule: These fields describe layout and progressive disclosure only. Capability and action arrays contain only exact production-inventory IDs; labels, availability gates and behavior are never duplicated here.

existingProduction.rule: This machine-readable inventory is the only authority for preserved features, executable actions, permissions, modules, flags, plan entitlements and source symbols.

contractLayers.implementationRule: Render every existingProduction capability and every production action exactly once on its owning route; IDs retain production-inventory order, and actions retain kind, placement and gates. New business behavior requires a separate approved product contract.

statePolicy.effectiveStateSet: union(always, byArchetype[route.archetype], route.requiredStates, mutationStates when production inventory contains a mutation)

responsiveCompositionPolicy.authority: viewport selects the application shell; the route responsiveProfile then selects its composition. A route may use a container query inside that composition, but may not invent a conflicting viewport breakpoint.

dashboard-grid.summary: mobile 1–2 KPI columns and one content column; compact 2 KPI columns and stacked primary panels; desktop 4 KPI columns and intentional 2-column sections
dashboard-grid.mobileMax860: one task column; KPI 1 column through 560 then 2; actions remain reachable
dashboard-grid.compact861To1180: two KPI columns; primary panels stack; no squeezed side rail
dashboard-grid.desktop1181Plus: four KPI columns; two-column sections only where reading order remains clear

planboard.summary: mobile agenda plus non-drag wizard; 861–1279 collapsible queue and locally scrolling board; inline queue from 1280
planboard.mobileMax860: agenda is default; queue precedes agenda; explicit timeline; all placement through touch-safe non-drag flow
planboard.compact861To1180: full board with sticky axes and locally scrolling time canvas; queue is collapsible or Sheet
planboard.desktop1181Plus: full board; queue remains collapsible through 1279 and is inline from 1280

data-view.summary: cards through 860; semantic table with local overflow from 861; identical fields, selection and actions
data-view.mobileMax860: record cards with complete data/action parity and filters in Sheet
data-view.compact861To1180: semantic table; local horizontal overflow only after column prioritization
data-view.desktop1181Plus: full semantic table and toolbar; no page-level horizontal overflow

dossier.summary: mobile section selector and bottom action Sheet; compact single column plus detail Sheet; sticky action rail from 1181
dossier.mobileMax860: single column; section selector; actions in safe-area bottom Sheet
dossier.compact861To1180: single main column; secondary/detail actions in Sheet or floating trigger
dossier.desktop1181Plus: main dossier plus sticky action rail; subordinate tables may use data-view profile

inbox.summary: mobile list-first cards and detail route/Sheet; compact stacked list/detail; desktop inbox plus preview
inbox.mobileMax860: list-first cards; open selected item in route or full-height Sheet
inbox.compact861To1180: stacked list and detail; no narrow permanent preview
inbox.desktop1181Plus: inbox plus preview when both panes retain useful width

editor.summary: mobile single-column editor with secondary panels in Sheets; compact central editor with collapsible panels; desktop task-appropriate multi-panel layout
editor.mobileMax860: single column; sticky actions do not obscure content; secondary controls in Sheets
editor.compact861To1180: one or two safe columns; secondary panels collapsible
editor.desktop1181Plus: multi-panel only when every panel retains its contracted minimum width

website-studio.summary: single canvas plus Sheets through 860; canvas with drawers from 861–1279; three panes from 1280
website-studio.mobileMax860: canvas primary; library and properties are full-height Sheets/tabs
website-studio.compact861To1180: canvas primary; both side panels are collapsible drawers
website-studio.desktop1181Plus: drawers through 1279; library + canvas + properties from 1280

settings-form.summary: single-column form through 860; one or safe two columns at compact desktop; two columns for related short fields on desktop
settings-form.mobileMax860: one column with labels above fields and non-obscuring actions
settings-form.compact861To1180: one or two columns only when the field container is at least 584px
settings-form.desktop1181Plus: two columns for related short fields; long/complex fields span the row

settings-index.summary: drawer/select through 860; horizontal index at 861–1180; sticky left index from 1181

article.summary: one readable column on mobile; related metadata stacks at compact widths; bounded main plus optional rail on desktop
article.desktop1181Plus: bounded readable main; optional related-content rail

wizard.summary: one-column full-height/bottom Sheet on mobile; centered scrollable step Dialog on desktop
wizard.mobileMax860: one-column, safe-area aware step flow without horizontal stepper
wizard.compact861To1180: centered or side step Dialog with internal scroll
wizard.desktop1181Plus: centered step Dialog; summary and actions remain visible

auth.summary: single accessible card at every width; one-column form and host-resolved branding
auth.mobileMax860: single card within 17px gutters and safe areas; keyboard cannot obscure action
auth.desktop1181Plus: bounded single card with optional nonessential brand panel

single-purpose.summary: one bounded task surface at every width; print and phone output fit without page overflow

generatedAgainst.rule: This is a source snapshot, not proof that the observed branches remain current. W00 must fetch, synchronize and regenerate/review the inventory before implementation.

globalRequirements: Every source page stays represented; deleting or silently redirecting functionality fails the gate.
Read and write permissions are enforced server-side; hidden UI is not authorization.
Every mutation has pending, success and recoverable error feedback.
Every list provides meaningful empty, filtered-empty, loading and failure states.
Every destructive action uses AlertDialog and states consequence and target.
Every create/edit flow uses a Sheet or step Dialog according to complexity.
All visible copy is Dutch unless it is tenant-authored content.
All user-facing surfaces use effective tenant branding without cross-tenant cache leakage.
All routes meet the mandatory viewport and keyboard acceptance matrix.
